text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон dominates the Shuka Sho
and
successfully claims the Triple Tiara!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She gives me a shout-out at the
post-race press
conference, citing me as
her trusty partner and
the reason behind
her progress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She goes on to challenge Нарита Брайан to
a
one-on-one at the upcoming Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан watches the broadcast in
real time
and laughs to herself,
impressed—but not
intimidated.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
